title: Delivery
description: The current state of a delivery including driver and tracking details.

order_uuid.description: The UUID of the associated order.

status.description: The current lifecycle status of the delivery.

pickup_eta.description: Estimated time of arrival at the pickup location.

dropoff_eta.description: Estimated time of arrival at the delivery location.

tracking_url.description: A URL providing real-time delivery status updates, courier tracking, courier name, and contact options.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last delivery status update.
